lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A highly structured grid of high-luminance circular spots is visible on the lateral flank. The spots are organized into distinct vertical columns, with approximately 4 to 5 spots per column in the mid-flank region, maintaining consistent spatial intervals between centroids.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are aligned with the spot columns. These bands intersect with horizontal alignments of spots, creating a lattice-like pattern where the high-luminance blobs serve as nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge (carina) is visible along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance transition. The dorsal edge of the ridge reflects higher light levels, while the ventral edge is defined by a narrow band of shadow, running parallel to the longitudinal axis.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Approximately 3 to 5 small, low-contrast high-luminance blobs are sparsely distributed near the anterior base and lower mid-section of the first dorsal fin's silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a remora (Echeneidae) positioned ventrally below the mid-section of the shark, appearing as a high-contrast, linear, high-luminance object against the water column background.
